description: Regression corpus from the ZUI text-editor audit (docs/AUDIT.md G4). Each input must survive an editor import/export round trip byte-identically. Every one of these is corrupted by @lexical/markdown's line-oriented transformers.

cases.name: blockquote-blank-line
cases.why: the audited editor added a second > to the blank quote line

cases.name: blockquote-nested
cases.why: the audited editor flattened and re-prefixes nested quotes

cases.name: backslash-hard-break
cases.why: the audited editor doubled the backslash on every save

cases.name: windows-path
cases.why: the audited editor doubled backslashes in plain text

cases.name: tilde-fence
cases.why: the audited editor escaped tildes, destroying the fence

cases.name: double-backtick-code
cases.why: the audited editor escaped the backticks

cases.name: loose-list-second-paragraph
cases.why: the audited editor inserted a stray blank line

cases.name: setext-heading
cases.why: the audited editor kept it as paragraph text with a line break

cases.name: indented-code
cases.why: the audited editor showed it as literal paragraph text

cases.name: reference-link
cases.why: the audited editor never parsed it (audit G2)

cases.name: reference-image
cases.why: the audited editor never parsed it (audit G2)

cases.name: image-inline
cases.why: the audited editor rendered a literal ! plus a link (audit G1)

cases.name: image-with-title
cases.why: the audited editor rendered a literal ! plus a link (audit G1)

cases.name: autolink
cases.why: the audited editor kept it as text

cases.name: html-block
cases.why: the audited editor showed raw source in prose (audit G3)

cases.name: html-comment
cases.why: the audited editor showed raw source in prose (audit G3)

cases.name: ordered-list-start
cases.why: the audited editor renumbered from 1 (audit G11)

cases.name: soft-break
cases.why: the audited editor turned a soft break into a hard line break (audit G5)

cases.name: underscore-emphasis
cases.why: the audited editor normalized to asterisks, changing the source

cases.name: thematic-break-variants
cases.why: the audited editor rewrote every variant to ---

cases.name: entity
cases.why: the audited editor double-escaped the entity

cases.name: blank-line-runs
cases.why: the audited editor collapsed to one blank line
